title: Visual Task Modeling and Automated Planning for Humanoid Robots in Education of Individuals with Autism Spectrum Disorder
abstract: arXiv:2610.27162v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In robot-assisted education, a robot must understand how to complete a task in order to effectively guide a student through it. We present a novel method that enables a semi-autonomous, camera-equipped robot to recognise the task goal and plan actions to achieve it. Our work focuses on Shoebox Tasks, an activity commonly used in the education of individuals with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD). These tasks are designed so that the goal can be inferred directly from their visual structure. We have developed a solver that uses a vision-based Large Language Model to convert photos of a Shoebox Task into a Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL) representation and generate action plans for solving it. We have also implemented a robotic interface that enables a Nao robot to autonomously execute various Shoebox Tasks and assist a student by suggesting next steps or signalling detected failures through action demonstrations, voice commands,

translated_title: 面向自闭症谱系障碍个体教育的人形机器人视觉任务建模与自动规划
translated_abstract: 在机器人辅助教育中，机器人必须理解如何完成一项任务，才能有效地指导学生完成任务。我们提出了一种新颖的方法，使配备摄像头的半自主机器人能够识别任务目标并规划实现目标的动作。我们的工作聚焦于鞋盒任务，这是一种常用于自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）个体教育活动中的任务。这些任务的设计使得目标可以直接从其视觉结构中推断出来。我们开发了一个求解器，利用基于视觉的大语言模型将鞋盒任务的照片转换为规划领域定义语言（PDDL）表示，并生成解决该任务的动作计划。我们还实现了一个机器人接口，使Nao机器人能够自主执行各种鞋盒任务，并通过动作演示、语音指令等方式建议下一步操作或对检测到的失败发出信号，从而协助学生学习。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种利用视觉大语言模型将自闭症教育中鞋盒任务的照片自动转换为PDDL表示并生成动作计划的方法，使Nao人形机器人能够识别任务目标、自主规划行动，并通过动作演示和语音指令辅助学生完成任务。
en_tdlr: This study presents a novel method that uses a vision-based large language model to convert photos of Shoebox Tasks (commonly used in autism education) into PDDL representations and automatically generate action plans, enabling a Nao humanoid robot to recognize task goals, plan autonomously, and assist students through action demonstrations and voice commands.
